Dave "I'll never break the hour again" McMullen only had 2 minutes 44 seconds to spare and Len Evans, Martin Bennett and John Dunsford also were under the hour.
As has been the case over recent months, Martin Bennett held his own fairly comfortably. He was, however, a little worried by newly signed Paul Wiltshire but still managed to win clearly.
The combined Junior and Senior 6 miles was last away and for the Juniors Belgrave had Martin Bennett who produced a class 18th in a field of 100 plus.
A fourth by Martin Bennett in the Junior 5 miles and Jonathon Dunsford in the Boys 1¾ miles were the highest we could produce in these races.
Junior Martin Bennett managed a fast 14:16.2 for 3000m at Crystal Palace on Wednesday March 21st in the Southern Counties Meeting, only a second behind former international Arthur Thomson.

At Bebington, Cheshire, in the English Schools Meeting, Jonathon Dunsford finished a close 3rd in the Junior Boys 3km with a personal best of 14:38. In the Senior 5km Martin Bennett produced 5th place in 24:33 although he was never happy.

The afternoon started with a win for Carl Lawton in the 3 kilos, followed up by Len Duquemin winning the 10 kilos. 1,3 and 4 was the result for Belgrave in the under 18 2 kilo event won convincingly by Martin Bennett with Jonathon Dunsford 3rd and Stuart Bennett next home.
